rows.note: For the clothing sense, this is the all-purpose everyday choice for a complete set of clothes worn together.

example.english: I’m wearing an outfit to have dim sum today.
example.traditional: 我今日着住一套衫去飲茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 jat1 tou3 saam1 heoi3 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this for a cohesive organized group or unit of people, including a military formation.

example.english: This outfit is very well trained.
example.jyutping: ne1 zi1 deoi6 ng5 fan3 lin6 dak1 hou2 hou2

rows.note: Use this when “outfit” means a business or firm rather than a group of people generally.

example.english: That outfit specializes in designing weddings.
example.traditional: 嗰間公司專門幫人設計婚禮。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 bong1 jan4 cit3 gai3 fan1 lai5
